Get to know Blossom

What is Blossom Pediatric?

Blossom Pediatric is a coordinated group of individual child-development professionals. We are not a physical clinic.

Experts working with Blossom assess your child’s needs. We then arrange a suitable professional for one-to-one support at home, and coordinate the care plan, parent guidance and review.

Individual expertise. A shared focus on your child.

The experience our professionals bring

400+clients

Supported across the combined experience of the professionals who work with Blossom, across India.

Your child needs support. Your day needs room for it.

Repeated appointments can mean arranging transport, taking time away from work and managing the rest of the family around each visit. We recognise that effort.

Costs beyond the fee

Questions after the visit

Talk through our approach

The reason behind the care

Progress that matters in everyday life.

The goal is your child’s development. Assessment helps identify meaningful goals for communication, independence, learning and participation, based on their strengths and support needs.

Communication & connection

Working towards ways to express needs and take part in everyday interactions.

Everyday independence

Supporting participation in play, self-care, movement and familiar routines.

Learning & participation

Building useful skills and engagement through support that fits the child’s pace and needs.

These are examples of goal areas. Your child’s assessment guides their individual plan.

Before you get in touch

Clear answers to the questions that matter.

Do I have to choose a therapy or professional myself?

No. Share your concern with Blossom. The relevant expert assessment guides the recommended support, and we arrange a suitable professional.

Will the same professional continue with my child?

We aim for consistency where clinically and operationally appropriate. If a change is needed, the reason and transition plan are explained so your family understands what happens next.

Is home care suitable for every child?

The expert recommendation guides suitability, support and delivery format. Home visits depend on your location and professional availability. Some needs may require a different setting or care beyond Blossom’s service scope.

Do you also offer online support?

Yes, when suitable for the child’s needs and session requirements. Home visits are Blossom’s main service; online arrangements are discussed individually.

Where can I see the session fees?

The current fees and care arrangements are available in our separate pricing guide.

The assessment conversation

Your child is more than a single concern.

An expert relevant to your child’s needs looks at the child and family context together. Your observations matter, including what is already going well.

You can bring questions and any relevant information you already have. The recommendation stays within the professional’s qualifications and scope.

Everyday routines

Your concerns

Existing support

The recommendation

A plan you can understand.

The assessment guides the support. Your family should know what is being recommended, why it may help, and what happens next.

Beyond the session

Guidance for you. Room to review.

Parents are part of the conversation. Guidance should fit family life and help you understand the plan.

Privacy & communication

This website does not collect medical reports or assessment details. Your language preference can be remembered in this browser. There are no analytics or advertising trackers on these pages.

WhatsApp and phone links continue the conversation through those channels. Ask Blossom how to share reports and how consent is handled before sending sensitive information.

For questions about your family’s information, contact Blossom on +91 63525 70501.

Understanding your care arrangement

The assessment guides the support, professional assignment, delivery format and session frequency. Home visits depend on suitability, location and availability.

Professional continuity is maintained where clinically and operationally appropriate. If a change is needed, the reason and transition plan are explained.

Confirm session duration, fees, inclusions, cancellations and rescheduling with Blossom before care begins. Full fee information is in the separate pricing guide.

Progress is individual. No developmental outcome or fixed timeline is guaranteed.
